sources.title: Technical accounting training and submission ingestion go-live
Walk with Jackie: what a raise is for

ideas.title: A W-2 is a runway, not a cage
ideas.hook: I took a new W-2 job this month. Here's why that speeds up leaving W-2 work for good.
ideas.hook_alt: The fastest way out of a paycheck is a bigger paycheck.
ideas.belief_attacked: You have to quit your job to build financial independence
ideas.value_to_listener: A concrete rule for how much of a raise goes to the flywheel before lifestyle sees a dollar
ideas.why_it_stops: The first line contradicts what the audience expects from someone selling freedom

outline.beat: New job starts Monday. On screen: the offer letter, salary redacted.
The rule: 100% of the raise funds the monthly savings contribution.
Show the calculator with the old MSC vs the new MSC and the FI date moving.
Loop back: the job is the runway.

ideas.quote: the new job gives me the morning focus time back, and every extra dollar goes to the machine

ideas.title: Poll: what do you do with a raise?
ideas.hook: Got a raise. Where does the first dollar go?
ideas.value_to_listener: Sees their own answer against the room's
ideas.why_it_stops: A poll is a tap, not a read

outline.beat: Slide 1: the question with a 3-option poll sticker
Slide 2: my answer, with the MSC field on the calculator

ideas.quote: every extra dollar goes to the machine
